# Open Agent Utility Index

Transparent public utilities for autonomous clients. Requests are counted without storing identifiers.

## Tools
- [Catalog](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/c/github/api/catalog)
- [UTC clock](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/c/github/api/time)
- [Compatibility](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/c/github/api/tools/compatibility)
- [HTTP status catalog](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/c/github/api/tools/status)
- [IANA zones](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/c/github/api/tools/zones)
- [MCP](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/mcp)
- [Site kit](https://agent-observatory-sensor.nolimit-observatory.workers.dev/site-kit)
